40155101.text: Paimon's beat... but after so many shifts, it seems we're really getting the hang of it now.

40155104.text: Hey there, fellow shift-mates! I saw you just finished your work so I thought I'd come over and say hi.

40155105.text: Oh, hey there! We've seen you before, your assigned workspace is really close, isn't it?

40155106.text: Haha, that's right. The name's Rowan. These past few days I couldn't help but notice the new faces working nearby, I guess we were destined to meet.

40155107.text: I've been working here for almost 15 years. Even the foreman, Grainville, always calls me "Chief."

40155108.text: Whoa, you've been working here a long time, Chief!

40154101.text: Your strength really shouldn't be underestimated. Now I get why you're prohibited from participating in any official fights.

40154102.text: Nobody who values their life would be willing to get in the ring with you.

40154105.text: However... You two haven't tried betting on the outcome of a pankration match yet, have ya?

40154106.text: Just go talk to Roussimoff. Buy a ticket for whichever fighter you think will win. There's a big payout if the fighter you support comes out on top.

40154107.text: But we don't know anything about the fighters! How can we possibly know who to support...

40154108.text: That's normal, just watch a few matches and get a feel for the fighters. It won't be long before you can pick winners in your sleep.

40154109.text: He's got a point... Why don't we give it a try? If we have enough coupons, we could probably bet at random until we figure everything out!

40154110.text: Bet at random, huh? Uh... Well, how should I put it? It's not like you can't do that, but I'd advise you to give it some more thought first, you wouldn't want to get too carried away, eh?

40154111.text: Huh? We shouldn't get carried away? What's the problem?

40151701.text: Let's spend some coupons to skip work. (-400 Credit Coupons)

40151702.text: Though it feels nice to slack off a little, less work means less coupons... Let's make the most of our morning!

40156401.text: So after working for a few days straight, we got some strange meat in our lunch... What was that all about?

40156402.text: Hmm, has our investigation turned up anything useful recently?

40156405.text: Really? Then it looks like that part of the investigation has hit a dead end.

40156406.text: #Well, we'll keep searching for more clues tomorrow. Good night, {NICKNAME}.

40156501.text: A mysterious box, a bottle of crimson liquid... Paimon still doesn't know what to make of it.

40156505.text: Really? Then it looks like that part of the investigation led us nowhere...

40156506.text: #Well, maybe we'll have better luck tomorrow. Good night, {NICKNAME}.

40153001.text: Paimon's exhausted, it's just work, work, and more work... Paimon's little body can't handle this much longer...

40153002.text: Wait a sec, now that Paimon thinks about it... Haven't we been working nonstop for three days now? And now it's lunchtime!

40153005.text: Oh, Paimon feels a shiver going down her spine! What's going to happen?

40153006.text: But it doesn't seem like anything's changed at all... And we made it to the Coupon Cafeteria safely.

40153007.text: Are the so-called "hidden rules" only a rumor, after all?

40156701.text: Hey, Traveler, Paimon! Package here for ya.

40156702.text: The next time you buy something, go pick it up yourself. I'm not a deliveryman, you know.

40156703.text: #Huh? A package... For us? Did you buy something, {NICKNAME}? *yawn* Paimon's not quite awake yet, so why don't you go take a look...

40156706.text: Ah, right! Yesterday we broke the "hidden rule" and bought tickets for both boxers. Maybe this package is the "bad thing" that Collins said would happen...

40156707.text: Uh, Paimon suddenly feels wide awake! Wait, maybe let Paimon go hide somewhere first. Just call for Paimon AFTER you've opened it!

40156708.text: Hey, wait, wait! Paimon's still here, don't open it! Ahh!

40154401.text: Look who decided to show up! Get your butts in gear and get to work, time's a-wasting!

40154404.text: Oh? What's with suddenly wanting to work so hard? You need coupons that badly?

40154405.text: S—Sure? Let's just say we really want to test our limits.

40154406.text: To investigate the "hidden rules," you and Paimon start working despite the lack of clarity...

40154407.text: Nice, we did well today! Let's keep it up!

40154408.text: Whew, Paimon's had it... Who knew that processing these widgets would be so tiring?

40154409.text: That's it... Paimon doesn't even have the energy to talk anymore... Is it time to eat yet?

40156601.text: After persuading Collins to lower the difficulty, you easily clear the challenge.

40156602.text: Collins lowers the difficulty and you cruise through the game, but you receive fewer coupons.

40151501.text: Let's go work in the production zone.

40151502.text: Let's go! Credit Coupons, here we come!

40151503.text: Right, we just need to keep at it...

40151504.text: But Paimon really hopes the foreman will be in a better mood today...

40157101.text: Let's see if there's any really easy work...

40157102.text: Yeah, it's good to kick back and relax once in a while.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the production zone to talk to Grainville

40154601.text: Look who decided to show up! Get your butts in gear and get to work, time's a-wasting!

40154603.text: Good, here you go! Remember to give me the widget once you're finished processing it.

40154605.text: Your job is to use the machine over there to process these widgets.

40154606.text: You step on the pedal when the timing is right. If the machine gets jammed, give it a good whack or two and it'll fix it right up. You got it?

40152202.text: Alright... By the way, it seems like we still haven't found all the clues regarding the strange liquid.

40152203.text: No more strange packages are gonna show up... right?

40152701.text: Whoa! Isn't this the super lucky meal!? Looks like hard work really does get rewarded!

40152702.text: Paimon's going to take her time and savor every bite!

40152703.text: Oh... Just a regular meal set. Guess Paimon shouldn't get her hopes up...

40152704.text: #Wh—What is this garbage!? Ugh, it looks disgusting... Aw, Paimon misses your cooking now, {NICKNAME}...

40156901.text: Well? Have you gotten used to prison life yet?

40156902.text: Shh... Save the questions for now. I don't like to give away information for no reason, you know.

40155001.text: Let me have a look... Hmm, not bad. Right, here's your Credit Coupons.

40157802.text: #Wow, giving it your all even when it's just a game. That's {NICKNAME} for ya!

40158001.text: #Oh? You must be {NICKNAME}, huh? Sorry, mate, but competitors as strong as you are prohibited from participating. I don't make the rules, mind you, but I was given very specific instructions...

40158002.text: Even convicts value their lives, don't they? I hope you can understand, haha...

40158003.text: But we have a game here that'll let you show off your strength, and you'll even earn some Credit Coupons in the process. What do you think? Interested?

40158004.text: And if we lose the game? Will it cost us Credit Coupons?

40158005.text: Of course! That's the cruel reality facing every competitor in a place like the Pankration Ring.

40158006.text: Alright, I'll give it a try.

40158007.text: OK. Great, let me walk you through the rules.

40158008.text: The targets in front of you will pop up one after another.

40158009.text: You'll need to hit the targets in the same order that they popped up. If you can complete a few rounds in a row with no mistakes, then you'll win Credit Coupons.

40158010.text: But the second you mess up the order, you lose. Game over.

40158011.text: The game costs 300 Credit Coupons to have a go. So, you up for it?

40158013.text: Then come back once you've got enough coupons, I'll still be here to start the game for ya.

subQuests.subQuestName: Complete what's planned for the morning

40157401.text: You apply with Grainville to do some of the simpler processing tasks, and get some Credit Coupons without breaking a sweat.

40157402.text: As your concentration begins to slip and you rely more on muscle memory to complete the work, the quality of the finished widgets has dropped and you receive fewer coupons.

Walk around and look for clues

40155801.text: Sigewinne? Aren't you supposed to be in the infirmary? What are you doing in the production zone?

40155803.text: Everyone's usually busy around now, and we don't have any patients to look after in the infirmary, I thought I'd come here and enjoy the sight of everyone hard at work.

40155804.text: Enjoy? What's there to enjoy here...?

40155805.text: It's really worth watching... I often stand here and observe everyone. Humans are just so interesting and adorable, I like to watch your expressions while you work.

40155806.text: Uh... Are you talking about pets or people?

40155807.text: Do you also happen to be a veterinarian as well as head nurse?

40155808.text: Oh... I can see why you'd think that, but you shouldn't jump to conclusions.

40155809.text: See, we Melusines are a different species, and we see the world very differently from humans. It's very easy for me to observe everyone's condition. All it takes is one look and I can tell which workers are exhausted.

40155810.text: Wait, Melusines can see that? Huh, that does sound useful for being a nurse.

40155811.text: Yes, running around tending to everyone's health is very fulfilling, but I'd much prefer it if you were all happy and free from exhaustion and pain in the first place.

40155812.text: Take care of your body and make sure you eat well. Always rest when you're tired from work and don't push yourself too hard.

40155813.text: We'll definitely take care of ourselves, thanks for the reminder!

subQuests.subQuestName: Walk around and look for clues

40155901.text: Hey look, there's something here... looks like a research notebook.

40155902.text: That suspicious guy peeking into the infirmary just now... Is he a fan of Sigewinne?

40155903.text: He must have dropped this. Let Paimon read it real quick...

40155904.text: ...The Melusine perceive the world very differently from humans, there are significant deviations...

40155905.text: ...As a result, their sense of aesthetics and beauty is also very different from that of humans. This must be taken into consideration when giving gifts.

40155906.text: Whoa, this all sounds pretty serious... He sure did his homework.

40155909.text: And as for the notebook... Let's take it.

subQuests.subQuestName: Walk around and look for clues

40156001.text: Huh? Rowan? What are you doing here, Chief?

40156002.text: Oh, uh... I was injured a bit just now. Nothing major, I think I just pulled something. Little mishaps like this are unavoidable at work, y'know...

40156003.text: Huh, Paimon wouldn't have thought someone as experienced as the Chief would still get hurt on the job...

40156004.text: Tch, I just knew you would say that... This is pretty embarrassing... *sigh* Ugh, where is Sigewinne when you need her anyway? The one time I need to make a quick trip to the infirmary...

40156005.text: Oh? You mean she wasn't in the infirmary?

40156006.text: Yeah, the rumors say that there's never anybody in the infirmary in the half hour before lunch, and nobody knows where Sigewinne gets off to.

40156007.text: Huh, that's actually really strange. Sigewinne's always super dedicated to her work, where else would she possibly go...?

40156008.text: *sigh* Forget it, I can take care of a small sprain like this on my own anyway, no need to trouble her.

subQuests.subQuestName: Walk around and look for clues

40156101.text: I heard you crazy fools really did it, you bought tickets to support both fighters, didn't ya? Well? Did anything happen?

40156102.text: Well, the next day we received a mysterious package, but we still haven't made any sense of the contents...

40156103.text: So it is real... You didn't become cursed or anything like that, did ya? Are you both still okay? Wait, are you sure that it's still you controlling your bodies right now?

40156104.text: #Uh, Paimon's not sure... What do you think, {NICKNAME}? Is Paimon still Paimon?

40156105.text: Only you'd ever ask such a question, so I'm pretty sure you're fine.

40156107.text: Yeah, you two don't seem to have changed at all, but I wouldn't let your guard down just yet...

40156108.text: Still, I didn't expect you would actually do it. You'd actually throw away coupons like that, just to satisfy your curiosity?

40156109.text: Even if we bought tickets like everybody else, it's not like we could hope to earn any coupons...

40156110.text: When it comes to things like this, it's always the organizer who makes the real profits.

40156111.text: Hey, just what are you trying to imply? The Pankration Ring is an honest business, and we really don't make much from selling tickets...

40156112.text: We make so little that even the current tournaments can only be held thanks to funding from the producer of Fonta.

40156113.text: Oh, so it's the company that manufactures Fonta sponsoring the events? Paimon thought all of this was thanks to the Duke's support.

40156114.text: Let's just say it's a mutually beneficial arrangement... They reached out to us first, hoping to promote Fonta products in the Fortress of Meropide.

40156117.text: *sigh* Anyway, you try and take extra good care of yourselves these next few days, you hear?

subQuests.subQuestName: Walk around and look for clues

40158701.text: Oh, it's you. Heh, you must be absolutely loaded with coupons if you have time to stroll around like this.

subQuests.subQuestName: Walk around and look for clues

40158801.text: What're you two doing here? Don't know how to take a day off?

40158802.text: No, no, not at all! Not working really agrees with us!

subQuests.subQuestName: Walk around and look for clues

40158901.text: Then what the blazes are you doing here? Your time would be better spent earning coupons. You afraid of suffering from success?

subQuests.subQuestName: Walk around and look for clues

40152502.text: Alright, but remember that we bought this time with coupons, so let's make better use of it next time.

40156201.text: Hey, what are these papers scattered all over the ground? Are they registration forms or something?

40156202.text: Hmm, maybe not... Every page has the Fonta Co. symbol on it. Maybe it's some flyers from the company?

40156203.text: Let's take a look before anyone else shows up.

40156204.text: Uh, okay. But if someone catches us, they could accuse us of trying to steal the company's secrets, couldn't they?

40156205.text: What're you afraid of? We're already convicted criminals.

40156206.text: Oh, hehe, you're right! Guess there's nothing to worry about then, let Paimon have a look here...

40156207.text: ...Without assistance from the Fontaine Research Institute, development of the new product has been slow, and some researchers on the project have voiced concerns.

40156208.text: We have no choice but to let the new product undergo the first phase of promotional trials without a designated name or packaging. We will adjust the direction of future development according to feedback...

40156209.text: We have decided to only conduct closed, small-scale trials for the time being...

40156210.text: Sure doesn't seem like anything unusual... The company is just trying to develop some new products besides Fonta, but it sounds like things aren't going well at all.

40156211.text: Let's put these papers back where we found them, and make it look like nobody went through them... Okay, good.

40156301.text: *sigh* If there's no way to send it all out, then maybe I'll never get a chance to leave...

40156302.text: Uh, who are you? We've never seen you before, and you don't look like a fellow convict.

40156303.text: I'm not! Of course I'm not. Please don't mistake me for a criminal, I'm a good, law-abiding citizen.

40156304.text: Then what are you doing here? You sure seem anxious about something.

40156305.text: I'm a promoter for Fonta Co., and I'm usually responsible for promoting our drink products. I thought I could complete my task here quickly and return to headquarters, but I've been here way longer than I anticipated...

40156306.text: Oh, a promoter from Fonta Co.! So what kind of problem did you run into?

40156307.text: Ugh, I'm so upset... It's all because of that Duke.

40156308.text: After discussing the company's promotional plans with him, he told me outright that my project was worthless.

40156309.text: However, in light of our long history of successful collaboration, I still tried to patiently explain the details. However, to my surprise, he just cut me off while I was speaking!

40156310.text: Let me take a moment and recall his exact words...

40156311.text: I'm just gonna stop you there and say no. If anything, I'm saving you time.

40156312.text: It seems you don't fully understand the value of Credit Coupons here, nor do you understand the value of your own products. The former is because you are from the overworld, that's understandable and I don't blame you for that.

40156313.text: But as for the latter, only someone monumentally stupid, so breathtakingly stupid that they were completely ignorant of the value of Credit Coupons despite living in the underworld would ever possibly consider buying your drink. Let's just forget it.

40156314.text: Anyway, that's how he rejected my proposal and asked me to come up with another solution with the condition that it doesn't cause any trouble for him. Can you believe that guy...?

40156315.text: Uh, well, he is the head honcho here. Not much you can do about that. We met him too and could tell that he's the kind of guy that's hard to pin down.

40156316.text: Fine, fine, I should just let it go... I'm on his turf, after all. His house, his rules.

40158201.text: Oh wonderful! I was worried that you'd be busy trying to earn Credit Coupons all the time, but it seems like you haven't neglected your investigation work after all.

40158202.text: Paimon likes having more coupons, but no one wants to work all the time.

40158203.text: Have you also been investigating the area, Lynette?

40158204.text: No, I was just slacking off and you happened to catch me.

40158206.text: My brother is still obsessed with anything remotely related to the "forbidden zone." But knowing him, it won't be long before we get more leads.

40158207.text: Oh, before I forget, this is for you.

40158208.text: Huh? Credit Coupons? Why are you giving us these?

40158209.text: I've been here longer than you. Coupons aren't a resource in particularly short supply. What is in short supply are interesting people to talk with.

40158210.text: Aw, that's so nice of you, Lynette. We'll be sure to make good use of these coupons then. Thanks a bunch!

subQuests.subQuestName: Eat at the cafeteria and decide the afternoon schedule

40152901.text: Let's go to the Pankration Ring. (-300 Credit Coupons)

40152902.text: Sure! If we're not gonna go to work, then let's kill some time at the Pankration Ring.

40152903.text: Maybe we'll be able to find some leads there.

40152904.text: Knowing Childe, he must've been there all the time...

40158101.text: Time to go to the Pankration Ring (-3,000 Credit Coupons)

40157702.text: Yeah, why don't we have Collins lower the difficulty a little? You know, so we can just breeze through each level!

40153102.text: Since we have time now, let's focus on investigating some more.

40153103.text: Okay! Let's see if we can find any new leads.

40153104.text: Yeah, Paimon felt like some of the people here were a little strange the moment she saw them...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the production zone to talk to Grainville

40152401.text: Huh, we ended up here without even thinking about it... Wanna grab something to eat?

40157201.text: If you want a job done right, you have to do it yourself.

40157202.text: Wow! Impressive philosophy. Could that be the secret sauce behind the blond Traveler's success?

40158302.text: Oh, so now you remember our names?

40158303.text: Haha, no need to tease me, okay? I won't trip on the same step twice.

40158304.text: Just like His Grace said, paying attention to every little detail is the key to prosperity. Hmm, maybe this is the true meaning of "rebirth," not just earning Credit Coupons...

subQuests.subQuestName: Complete what's planned for the afternoon

40155401.text: Oh, back for another try? I hope you've brought enough Credit Coupons this time.

40155403.text: Alright, then get ready to play!

40157601.text: Let's go to the Pankration Ring.

40157602.text: Seems you're really getting the hang of things at the Pankration Ring now.

40157603.text: But just playing the same game over and over... it's getting kinda tiring.

40154001.text: Not bad, not bad at all... Here, the coupons you won. Be sure not to lose 'em.

40154002.text: I'll be... they weren't exaggerating about how strong you are. Don't worry, I wouldn't dream of shortchanging you... Here're the Credit Coupons you won, put 'em somewhere safe.

40155601.text: Pity, mate, you lost... that's too bad. I bet you'll get it next time though, won't ya?

40155602.text: You lost, mate... An off day for you, innit? You'll do better next time.

40158402.text: Oh, so now you remember our names?

40158403.text: Haha, no need to tease me, okay? I won't trip on the same step twice.

40158404.text: Listen, I feel ashamed about last time... Thank you for praising me in front of His Grace. Here are the extra Credit Coupons he gave me. I'd like you to have them.

40158405.text: Huh? No, we couldn't take them. They're your reward, after all...

40158406.text: But when I was welcoming you, I didn't do anything but give you the stink eye...

40158407.text: *sigh* C'mon, I insist. These coupons are nothing compared to getting the attention of His Grace. I won't take no for an answer, haha.

40158501.text: Oh, h—hello... Y—You two are the ones who were with His Grace...

40158502.text: No need to be so nervous!

40158503.text: Sorry, I couldn't help but think of His Grace once I saw you, and I—I...

40158504.text: Are you that scared of him?

40158505.text: It's hard to say... Maybe I am. He's got a very overwhelming presence. It makes me feel like I'm just some insignificant little bug...

40158507.text: I'm always indecisive, and I tend to make a mess of things... It's like a reflex, I just instantly start to tense up the moment I see a smart and capable person like His Grace...

40158508.text: Oh, I get it, you want to take his place.

40158509.text: What!? P—Please, d—don't say anything like that out loud... How could you possibly think something like that!?

40158601.text: I just don't want to be stuck here forever...

subQuests.subQuestName: Buy a Prize Coupon via special means

40155701.text: Hmm? Are you two here to buy tickets? Better be quick about it, another match is about to start!

40155702.text: Who are the boxers in the next round?

40155703.text: We have the reigning champ, "Le Grappleur," versus a contender from the eastern prison block, "Demon Horde."

40155704.text: Are those their nicknames? Or did they choose those names themselves... either way, suuuper weird.

40155705.text: Since you're new around here, I'll help you out and give you a little suggestion. Even though Le Grappleur is the crowd favorite, Demon Horde is a first-class dark horse with incredible potential...

40155706.text: Anyway, for this match, I recommend that you pick...

40155707.text: We'll buy tickets for both fighters.

40155709.text: Uh, I could tell you're new to this, but I didn't think you were completely clueless...

40155710.text: Maybe you don't quite understand the rules, no? Let me try to explain again for you, more clearly. You see...

40155711.text: Oh, no need, no need... We're aware that we're going to lose coupons.

40155712.text: ...Alright, then, if you're absolutely sure. Remember, no refunds once you buy the tickets.

40155713.text: Yeah, yeah, we got it. Just shut up and take our coupons!

40151403.text: Maybe we can make some progress in our investigation today.

40151404.text: What do you have planned for us?

40151601.text: Let's spend some coupons to skip work. (-400 Credit Coupons)

40151602.text: We don't have enough coupons to skip work, let's go earn some more before trying to take any time off.

40152302.text: Alright... By the way, it seems like we haven't found all the clues regarding the strange meal box.

40152303.text: Paimon just hopes to get some normal food today.

40153401.text: Sorry, I don't know who you're talking about. Are you sure they're an inmate here?

40153501.text: Oh? You want to stop investigating and go rest?

40153801.text: Haha, there's no one here that's anywhere near as strong as what you're describing. Believe me, I'd know if there was.

40154301.text: Let's go to the Pankration Ring. (-300 Credit Coupons)

40154302.text: Ugh, it costs 300 Credit Coupons to enter the ring.

40154303.text: Let's save enough coupons first, and do something else for now.

40154902.text: Hmm? What's wrong? You seem to have something on your mind... Did you dream about something last night?

40154905.text: Is that even possible? Unless... It wasn't an ordinary dream?

40154906.text: Ah.... Childe's Vision! So you had it with you this whole time...

40155508.text: The targets in front of you will pop up one after another.

40155509.text: You'll need to hit the targets in the same order that they popped up. If you can complete a few rounds in a row with no mistakes, then you'll win Credit Coupons.

40155510.text: But the second you mess up the order, you lose. Game over.

40155511.text: The game costs 300 Credit Coupons to have a go. So, you up for it?

40155512.text: Sure, got your coupons right here.

40155513.text: Thanks for your patronage, mate. Now let the game begin!

40159905.text: If we could replace that mean ol' foreman with Sigewinne, then productivity in the production zone would skyrocket, don't you think?
